text_block_list.text:
We decided to have lunch outside today,
and while sitting at a family restaurant with Sweep Tosho—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew~, I'm so full!
I might have eaten a bit too much.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Still, this place is actually pretty good.
I wonder what I should eat next time I come...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I heard if you order this "Kids' Plate,"
it comes with a magic crystal pendant!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, why didn't you notice, familiar?!
If I'd known, I would've eaten this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmm... I'm stuffed, but I'm gonna eat this too...!
choice_data_list: Eating any more than this is overeating.
Do your best to become a great witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The master says she wants a precious magic tool,
so we're rolling again, and that's final!

I explain that I'm worried about her health if she overeats...
but she refuses to listen.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I said I'm gonna eat it, and I am!
I'm not going home until I finish this!"
choice_data_list: Then I'll eat it in your place!
Then I'll eat it in your place!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't I think of that!
Excuse me! One Kids' Meal for this person, please!

Though I wished she wouldn't say it so loudly,
Sweep Tosho looked so satisfied having gotten the toy
that it gave me a sense of accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, naturally!
I'm definitely getting that magic crystal!

Though visibly bloated and struggling, Sweep Tosho
splendidly polished off the kids' meal
and got her toy pendant!
